moments.title: I'm A Celeb is BACK!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! launched on ITV1 on Monday 16th November, with Ant & Dec hosting from Australia and a line-up including Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, and Chloe Burrows.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: The jungle gates are open! I'm A Celeb 2026 kicked off last night and we're already hooked. Who's your early favourite for King or Queen of the Jungle?

angles.name: Line-up Chat
angles.copy: Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, Chloe Burrows... the I'm A Celeb line-up is certainly an interesting mix this year! Who are you most excited (or terrified) to see in the Bushtucker Trials?

angles.name: Welsh Connection (Joanna Page)
angles.copy: Gavin & Stacey's Joanna Page is in the jungle! Sending all our support to the Welsh queen as she faces those creepy crawlies on I'm A Celeb. Bring home the crown, Jo!

moments.title: Strictly Heads to Blackpool!
moments.blurb: After Will Best and Dianne Buswell's elimination, eight couples are heading to the iconic Blackpool Tower Ballroom for Strictly Come Dancing's highly anticipated Blackpool Week on Saturday 21st November.

angles.name: Blackpool Excitement
angles.copy: It's the most wonderful time of the Strictly year! Get ready for glitter, glamour, and some seriously big routines as the couples hit the iconic Blackpool Tower Ballroom this Saturday!

angles.name: Who will shine?
angles.copy: Blackpool Week is make or break for many Strictly contestants. Who do you think will truly shine under the glitterball lights this Saturday? Let us know your predictions!

moments.title: Jamie Miller Still Number 1
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' holds onto the Official Singles Chart top spot for an 11th week, while Queens of the Stone Age's 'Perfecth' debuts at number one on the albums chart. Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' re-enters the top 5.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is number one on the Official Singles Chart for an incredible 11th week. Is it your favourite track right now?

angles.name: Album & Classic Climber
angles.copy: Queens of the Stone Age hit #1 with 'Perfecth' on the albums chart, and Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' is back in the singles top 5! What a week for music!

moments.title: Happy 66th to RuPaul!
moments.blurb: Today, November 17th, RuPaul Andre Charles, the iconic American drag performer, actor, and musician, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Drag Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the one and only RuPaul! The Supermodel of the World continues to slay. What's your favourite RuPaul track or moment? #RuPaul

angles.name: Music & TV
angles.copy: From 'Supermodel (You Better Work)' to RuPaul's Drag Race, RuPaul has left an indelible mark on music and television. Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to a true legend!

moments.title: Hanson's Isaac Turns 46
moments.blurb: Isaac Hanson, the eldest brother and guitarist/vocalist of the pop-rock band Hanson, celebrates his 46th birthday today, November 17th.

angles.name: Hanson Birthday
angles.copy: Mmmbop, ba duba dop! Happy 46th Birthday to Isaac Hanson! What's your favourite Hanson song that still gets stuck in your head?

angles.name: 90s Pop Flashback
angles.copy: Remember when Hanson took over the world? Isaac Hanson is 46 today! Feeling nostalgic for those 90s pop-rock anthems? #90sMusic

moments.title: Jethro Tull Guitarist Martin Barre is 80
moments.blurb: Martin Barre, the acclaimed guitarist for the legendary progressive rock band Jethro Tull, celebrates his 80th birthday today, November 17th.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 80th Birthday to the incredible Martin Barre, legendary guitarist of Jethro Tull! What's your favourite Jethro Tull riff?

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: An absolute icon of progressive rock turns 80 today! Happy Birthday to Martin Barre. His guitar work with Jethro Tull is timeless. #MartinBarre

moments.title: Go West's Peter Cox Turns 70
moments.blurb: Peter Cox, the distinctive vocalist and one half of the popular 80s pop duo Go West, celebrates his 70th birthday today, November 17th.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 70th Birthday to Peter Cox from Go West! From 'We Close Our Eyes' to 'King of Wishful Thinking', his voice defined an era. What's your Go West favourite?

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 70th to Peter Cox! The Go West frontman still sounds incredible. What's your favourite memory of their music? #PeterCox

moments.title: Deep Purple Rock The O2
moments.blurb: Rock legends Deep Purple are set to play London's O2 Arena on Sunday 22nd November as part of their UK arena tour, with support from Mammoth WVH and Jayler.

angles.name: Concert Hype
angles.copy: Smoke on the water! Deep Purple are bringing their legendary sound to The O2 in London this Sunday! Who's ready to rock out with these icons?

angles.name: Classic Rock Live
angles.copy: Still making waves after decades! Deep Purple live at The O2 this weekend – a must-see for any classic rock fan. What's your all-time favourite Deep Purple track?

moments.title: The Script Play Cardiff Tonight
moments.blurb: Irish pop-rockers The Script are performing tonight, November 17th, at Utilita Arena Cardiff with special guest James Morrison, as part of their 'The Man In The Arena' tour.

angles.name: Cardiff Gig Alert
angles.copy: Cardiff! The Script are in town TONIGHT at Utilita Arena with James Morrison! Who's heading out for what promises to be an epic night of live music? #TheScriptLive

angles.name: Pop-Rock Live
angles.copy: If you're in Cardiff tonight, The Script are ready to get the arena jumping! What song are you hoping to hear most from them?

moments.title: Welsh Drama 'Death Valley' Returns
moments.blurb: Season 2 of the Welsh-set crime drama 'Death Valley', starring Timothy Spall and Gwyneth Keyworth, premieres today, November 17th, on BritBox, with new episodes weekly.

angles.name: Welsh TV Premiere
angles.copy: Great news for Welsh drama fans! 'Death Valley' Season 2, filmed right here, premieres today on BritBox. Timothy Spall and Gwyneth Keyworth are back for more mysteries in the Welsh countryside!

angles.name: Crime Drama Watch
angles.copy: Looking for your next crime drama binge? 'Death Valley' returns today with a new season of unconventional sleuthing in Wales. Worth a watch?

moments.title: Miley Cyrus Turns 34
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Miley Cyrus, known for hits like 'Wrecking Ball' and 'Flowers', will celebrate her 34th birthday on Monday, November 23rd.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: She can buy herself flowers! Wishing a very Happy 34th Birthday to the one and only Miley Cyrus on Monday! What's your favourite Miley era?

angles.name: Miley's Impact
angles.copy: From Hannah Montana to global pop icon, Miley Cyrus turns 34 on Monday. Her career has been truly unforgettable! What's her best song?

moments.title: Black Friday Approaches
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially falls on Friday 27th November 2026, but many UK retailers have already started or will begin their sales earlier in the week.

angles.name: Shopping Frenzy
angles.copy: Get ready, shoppers! Black Friday officially lands on November 27th, but deals are already starting to drop. What's on your shopping list this year?

angles.name: Early Deals
angles.copy: Don't wait until the 27th! Many retailers are kicking off their Black Friday sales early this week. Have you bagged any bargains yet?

moments.title: Christmas Markets are Open!
moments.blurb: Numerous Christmas markets across the UK are now open or opening this week, including Winter Wonderland in Hyde Park (Nov 19), King's Cross Winter Market (Nov 26), and markets in Birmingham, Manchester, Cardiff, and York.

angles.name: Festive Fun
angles.copy: The festive season is truly here! Christmas markets across the UK are twinkling, mulled wine is flowing, and artisan gifts await. Which one will you visit first?

angles.name: London Markets
angles.copy: London is aglow! Hyde Park Winter Wonderland opens on Thursday, and King's Cross Winter Market next week. Get ready for some serious festive cheer!

angles.name: Welsh Markets
angles.copy: Cardiff Christmas Market is in full swing, bringing festive cheer to the city centre! Grab a hot chocolate and enjoy the atmosphere.

moments.title: Autumn Nations Championship Finals
moments.blurb: The inaugural Autumn Nations Championship culminates in a spectacular Finals Weekend at Twickenham Stadium from Friday 27th to Sunday 29th November, where Northern and Southern Hemisphere nations will compete for final standings.

angles.name: Rugby Finale
angles.copy: It's all building to this! The Autumn Nations Championship Finals Weekend kicks off at Twickenham on Friday 27th. Who are you backing to claim victory?

angles.name: International Rugby
angles.copy: The best of the Northern and Southern Hemispheres collide at Twickenham next weekend for the Autumn Nations Championship Finals. Get ready for some blockbuster rugby!

moments.title: Wales Face Australia in Rugby
moments.blurb: Wales will take on Australia at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Saturday 21st November as part of the Autumn Nations Championship.

angles.name: Welsh Rugby Battle
angles.copy: The Dragons are ready! Wales take on Australia this Saturday at Principality Stadium in a huge Autumn Nations Championship clash. Come on Cymru!

angles.name: Cardiff Match Day
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing for Saturday's big game! Wales vs Australia at Principality Stadium – who's got their tickets and their scarves ready? #WelshRugby

moments.title: England vs All Blacks Showdown
moments.blurb: England will host New Zealand's All Blacks at Twickenham Stadium on Saturday 21st November in a highly anticipated Autumn Nations Championship fixture.

angles.name: Twickenham Clash
angles.copy: England vs the All Blacks! Twickenham is set for a massive showdown this Saturday in the Autumn Nations Championship. Who's predicting an England win?

angles.name: Rugby Rivalry
angles.copy: One of rugby's greatest rivalries renews this weekend as England face the mighty All Blacks. Expect fireworks at Twickenham! #AutumnNationsSeries

moments.title: Myles Smith in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Rising star Myles Smith brings his 'My Mess, My Heart, My Life' tour to Utilita Arena Cardiff on Thursday 19th November.

angles.name: Cardiff Gig Hype
angles.copy: Myles Smith is heading to Utilita Arena Cardiff this Thursday! Who's excited to catch one of the UK's hottest new talents live? #MylesSmithLive

angles.name: New Music Live
angles.copy: If you're into fresh, exciting artists, Myles Smith is playing Cardiff on Thursday. His 'My Mess, My Heart, My Life' tour is getting rave reviews!

moments.title: Cunk on Cinema Lands on Netflix
moments.blurb: Diane Morgan returns as the brilliantly clueless Philomena Cunk in 'Cunk on Cinema', which premiered on Netflix on Sunday 15th November.

angles.name: Comedy Gold
angles.copy: Philomena Cunk is back! 'Cunk on Cinema' landed on Netflix on Sunday, bringing Diane Morgan's unique brand of investigative journalism to the world of film. Have you watched it yet?

angles.name: Netflix Binge
angles.copy: If you need a laugh, 'Cunk on Cinema' is now streaming on Netflix! Philomena Cunk's take on film history is as hilariously insightful as ever. #NetflixComedy
